description:
Retrieve a data stream by local update time. Behaves like the core getDataStream, but selects
        data points whose local `updated_at` timestamp falls within the inclusive [from, to] window
        instead of a sequence-id range.

        The request body is a serialized core DataStreamId (the same type used by getDataStream).
        `from` and `to` are ISO-8601 instants passed as query parameters. The response body is a
        serialized DataStreamBatch.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive start of the updated_at window, as an ISO-8601 instant (e.g. 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Inclusive end of the updated_at window, as an ISO-8601 instant (e.g. 2026-08-05T00:00:00Z).
